import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Scanner {
        private final BufferedReader br;
        private StringTokenizer st;

        public Scanner(InputStream in) {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(in));
            st = new StringTokenizer("");
        }

        public String next() {
            while (!st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                try {
                    String line = br.readLine();
                    if (line == null) return null;
                    st = new StringTokenizer(line);
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    throw new RuntimeException(e);
                }
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        public int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        public long nextLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }
    }

    static class Printer {
        private final BufferedWriter bw;

        public Printer(OutputStream out) {
            bw = new BufferedWriter(new OutputStreamWriter(out));
        }

        public void print(String s) throws IOException {
            bw.write(s);
        }

        public void println(String s) throws IOException {
            bw.write(s);
            bw.newLine();
        }

        public void flush() throws IOException {
            bw.flush();
        }
    }

    static class ModInt {
        private long v;
        private static int mod;
        private static boolean prime;

        public static void setMod(int m) {
            mod = m;
            prime = isPrime(m);
        }

        public static boolean isPrime(int n) {
            if (n <= 1) return false;
            if (n == 2 || n == 7 || n == 61) return true;
            if (n % 2 == 0) return false;
            long d = n - 1;
            while (d % 2 == 0) d /= 2;
            long[] bases = {2, 7, 61};
            for (long a : bases) {
                if (a >= n) continue;
                long t = d;
                long y = powMod(a, t, n);
                while (t != n - 1 && y != 1 && y != n - 1) {
                    y = (y * y) % n;
                    t <<= 1;
                }
                if (y != n - 1 && t % 2 == 0) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }

        public static long powMod(long base, long exp, int m) {
            long result = 1;
            long cur = base % m;
            while (exp > 0) {
                if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = (result * cur) % m;
                cur = (cur * cur) % m;
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        public ModInt() {
            this.v = 0;
        }

        public ModInt(long v) {
            this.v = v % mod;
            if (this.v < 0) this.v += mod;
        }

        public static ModInt raw(long v) {
            ModInt res = new ModInt();
            res.v = v;
            return res;
        }

        public ModInt add(ModInt rhs) {
            long res = this.v + rhs.v;
            if (res >= mod) res -= mod;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        public ModInt subtract(ModInt rhs) {
            long res = this.v - rhs.v;
            if (res < 0) res += mod;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        public ModInt multiply(ModInt rhs) {
            return new ModInt(this.v * rhs.v % mod);
        }

        public ModInt pow(long n) {
            long res = 1;
            long base = this.v;
            while (n > 0) {
                if ((n & 1) == 1) res = (res * base) % mod;
                base = (base * base) % mod;
                n >>= 1;
            }
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        public ModInt inv() {
            if (prime) {
                return this.pow(mod - 2);
            } else {
                long[] eg = invGCD(this.v, mod);
                return new ModInt(eg[1]);
            }
        }

        public static long[] invGCD(long a, long b) {
            a = ((a % b) + b) % b;
            if (a == 0) return new long[]{b, 0};
            long s = b, t = a;
            long m0 = 0, m1 = 1;
            while (t != 0) {
                long u = s / t;
                s -= t * u;
                long tmp = s;
                s = t;
                t = tmp;
                tmp = m0;
                m0 = m1;
                m1 = tmp;
                m0 -= m1 * u;
            }
            if (m0 < 0) m0 += b / s;
            return new long[]{s, m0};
        }

        public long val() {
            return v;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        Printer pr = new Printer(System.out);

        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int mod = sc.nextInt();
        ModInt.setMod(mod);

        ModInt[][] C = new ModInt[n + 1][n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                C[i][j] = new ModInt(0);
            }
        }
        C[0][0] = new ModInt(1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            C[i][0] = new ModInt(1);
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j - 1].add(C[i - 1][j]);
            }
        }

        ModInt[] g = new ModInt[n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            g[i] = new ModInt(i).multiply(new ModInt(i + 1)).multiply(new ModInt(1).add(new ModInt(0))); // placeholder for division by 2
            g[i] = new ModInt(i).multiply(new ModInt(i + 1)).multiply(new ModInt(1)).multiply(new ModInt(2).inv()); // i*(i+1)/2
        }

        class Pair {
            ModInt first, second;
            Pair(ModInt f, ModInt s) {
                this.first = f;
                this.second = s;
            }
        }

        Pair[] f = new Pair[n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            f[i] = new Pair(new ModInt(0), new ModInt(0));
        }
        f[0] = new Pair(new ModInt(1), new ModInt(0));

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                ModInt z = f[j].first.multiply(f[i - 1 - j].first).multiply(C[i - 1][j]);
                f[i].first = f[i].first.add(z.multiply(new ModInt(i + 1)));
                f[i].second = f[i].second.add(z.multiply(g[j].add(g[i - 1 - j])));
                f[i].second = f[i].second.add(
                        (f[i - 1 - j].first.multiply(f[j].second).add(f[j].first.multiply(f[i - 1 - j].second)))
                                .multiply(C[i - 1][j])
                                .multiply(new ModInt(i + 1))
                );
            }
        }

        // Debug output (can be omitted)
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            // System.err.println(i + " " + f[i].first.val() + " " + f[i].second.val() + " " + g[i].val());
        }

        ModInt[][] dp = new ModInt[n + 2][m + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                dp[i][j] = new ModInt(0);
            }
        }
        dp[0][0] = new ModInt(1);

        for (int l = 0; l <= n; l++) {
            for (int r = l + 1; r <= n + 1; r++) {
                int di = r - l - 1;
                for (int i = 0; i + di <= m; i++) {
                    ModInt z = dp[l][i].multiply(f[di].first);
                    dp[r][i + di] = new Pair(
                            dp[r][i + di].first.add(z.multiply(C[i + di][di])),
                            new ModInt(0)
                    ).first;
                    // For second value
                    ModInt val = (dp[l][i].second.multiply(f[di].first).add(dp[l][i].first.multiply(f[di].second)))
                            .multiply(C[i + di][di]);
                    dp[r][i + di] = new Pair(
                            dp[r][i + di].first,
                            dp[r][i + di].second.add(val)
                    ).second;
                }
            }
        }

        pr.println(Long.toString(dp[n + 1][m].second.val()));
        pr.flush();
    }
}
